study_question.question: Under which frozen reference, support, chart, and error conditions can an L4 technical vector become an L5 reference-relative score candidate?

claim.target_estimand: Reference-relative technical vector under a frozen facet measure, population chart, and generalization universe.
claim.claim_statement: This opened synthetic study tests but does not yet license the E45 reference-scoring edge.

assumptions: Reference, calibration, and scored panels are independent.
Reference population, target facet measure, chart, operator, and occasion universe are frozen.
Support and selection are identified over the target facet measure.
edge_licenses.evidence_or_test: Ten synthetic recovery, shift, alias, heavy-tail, and refusal worlds with observable-only uncertainty.
edge_licenses.refusal_rule: Retain the maximum license at L4 if any registered E45 gate fails.

target_population.definition: Authors generated by the registered balanced synthetic L45 target population.

reference_population.definition: Versioned synthetic reference population with target group weights 0.5 and 0.5.
reference_population.scope_limit: Reference coordinates are valid only for synthetic-l45-v1.
reference_population.refusal_consequence: Register a new reference version and recalibrate after drift.

context.definition: Sixteen registered synthetic facets used as contextual opportunities.
context.sampling_rule: The target facet measure is uniform and frozen.

opportunity.definition: Each author-occasion is eligible for every target facet.
opportunity.sampling_rule: Observed composition may shift but target support must remain positive.

occasion_time.sampling_rule: Occasions are generated independently conditional on the stable technical field.
occasion_time.scope_limit: These are not human trait occasions.

operator.definition: Frozen L4 vector operator plus weighted whitened reference chart.
operator.sampling_rule: One version is fitted and applied without cohort recentering.
operator.scope_limit: No transport through a noninvertible operator kernel.
operator.refusal_consequence: Refuse chart transport after operator drift or rank loss.

language_culture.definition: No language or culture exists in the synthetic vector world.

interaction_partner.definition: No interaction partner exists in the synthetic world.

administration.sampling_rule: Configuration and seed provenance are persisted.

response_process.definition: The study begins with an already identified L4 technical object.

observation_design.event_unit: One synthetic event mean with count and variance provenance.
observation_design.choice_channel: Facet availability and event composition are recorded separately.
observation_design.response_channel: Facet-conditional technical response vectors are retained.
observation_design.event_count_rule: Count is recorded for every author, occasion, and facet.
observation_design.event_composition_rule: Composition is standardized to frozen lambda and never replaced by count.
observation_design.repeated_opportunity_rule: Four independent occasions expose the same registered target support.
observation_design.missingness_selection_rule: Support holes and unknown facet provenance trigger typed refusal.
observation_design.text_retention_policy: No text is read; observed vector means, counts, and variances are retained.
observation_design.assisted_authorship_policy: Not applicable in the synthetic vector world.

transformation_chain.fit_apply_separation: Reference, calibration, and scored panels are generated independently and never cohort-recentered.
transformation_chain.reference_operator: uniform-lambda standardization followed by weighted reference whitening and frozen stable-subspace scoring
transformation_chain.provenance_rule: Config, source paths, seeds, manifest, metrics, decision, and artifact inventory are persisted.

reference_measurement.support_positivity_rule: lambda support must be observed in every scored occasion
reference_measurement.effective_sample_size_rule: report minimum target-to-observed importance-weight ESS ratio
reference_measurement.selection_identification_rule: facet provenance and opportunity support are mandatory; otherwise refuse

identification.target_functional: Facet-standardized reference-relative technical score and its uncertainty region.
identification.identification_set: Worlds sharing the declared population, facet support, occasion universe, and invertible chart.
identification.equivalence_class: A/Q-decomposition aliases share one score; their hidden cause labels remain unidentified.
assumptions: Facet provenance and target support are observed.
Reference, calibration, and score panels are independent.
Registered occasions are independent conditional replicates.
Reference mixture weights and target facet measure are declared.
alias_or_counterworlds: A/Q gauge alias with identical total technical field.
identification.support_condition: Target lambda is absolutely continuous with respect to author and reference facet support.
identification.dependence_model: Authors are independent; event means may be heteroskedastic and heavy-tailed; occasions must be declared independent.
identification.residual_claim: Residual coordinates and A/Q components are not assigned psychological or causal names.
refusal_rules: Refuse cause attribution under A/Q gauge aliases.

dependence_assumptions: Reference authors are the reference-resampling unit.
Scored authors remain fixed while their observed event means are resampled.
Calibration authors and occasions are resampled separately.
error_theory.variance_or_relation_decomposition: Reference, calibration-selection, event, occasion, and operator channels are reported separately.
error_theory.uncertainty_target: Reference-relative technical score under the frozen lambda and chart.
error_theory.uncertainty_method: Nested observed-only reference-author, calibration-author, and event-mean bootstrap.
error_theory.reference_uncertainty: Reference center and covariance are refitted inside every bootstrap draw.
error_theory.individual_sem: Not licensed in this opened discovery; candidate ellipsoids are calibration diagnostics only.
error_theory.minimum_detectable_difference: Split-sample MDD is evaluated synthetically but not licensed for human change interpretation.
error_theory.decision_consistency: Not applicable because no decision is enabled.

validation_route.development_confirmation_separation: This opened discovery uses fixed development seeds; formal confirmation must use a new seal and external randomness.
validation_route.fresh_confirmation_rule: A future confirmation uses at least 100 fresh repetitions and 1000 null worlds without retuning.
validation_route.external_construct_evidence: Not applicable; no psychological construct is requested.
validation_route.field_replication: Not applicable to synthetic discovery; mandatory for any human-text L5 instance.
validation_route.information_budget_plan: Discovery uses 192 reference, 96 calibration, 64 score authors, 16 facets, and four occasions.
validation_route.stop_rule: Any failed recovery, correction, uncertainty, or refusal gate yields REFUSE_L45_PROMOTION.

interpretation_boundary.claim_boundary: Bounded synthetic E45 test only; L5 promotion remains blocked pending separately sealed confirmation and a real study-specific G/D design.

application_overlay.consequences_analysis: Not applicable because no decision is enabled.
application_overlay.fairness_analysis: Not applicable in the synthetic world; mandatory downstream.
application_overlay.human_authority: Not applicable because no human score is produced.

governance.mutation_policy: This is opened discovery; changes create a new version and cannot be relabelled as confirmation.
